column9: The Nollywood Creative Minds Forum (NCMF) is a professional association of Nigerian film practitioners established in 2015 to promote professional development, collaboration, creativity and excellence within the Nigerian film industry, popularly known as Nollywood.
column10: The mission of the Nollywood Creative Minds Forum (NCMF) is to promote excellence, professionalism, creativity and collaboration within the Nigerian film and entertainment industry by providing a platform for capacity development, knowledge sharing, networking, mentorship and the empowerment of creative talents.

Since its establishment in 2015, the Nollywood Creative Minds Forum has organised seminars, film screenings, industry engagements and professional development activities aimed at promoting excellence and collaboration in Nollywood.
Some of its publicly documented events and activities include the following.
1. Annual In Pursuit of Better Seminar
The In Pursuit of Better seminar is NCMF's flagship annual industry gathering.
Its purpose is to bring together filmmakers, actors, producers, directors, financial experts, legal practitioners and other stakeholders to discuss the development of Nollywood.
